Their background is predominantly in full-stack web development, DevOps, and open-source tooling, with no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or performance modeling for AI accelerators.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical education
Extensive experience with performance-critical systems and low-latency applications
concerns: No visible experience with SoC, IP, or AI accelerator modeling
Lacks background in deep learning optimization or GPU architecture
